title: 4th trial reporter Yoga Pratama
paragraphs: The 4th trial for defamation against reporters Info Sumatra, Yoga Pratama, has been held.
According to the charges, Yoga Pratama published a report about the waste of the palm oil plant on July 25th, 2025 which the prosecutor judged attacked the honor of an official.
The trial was held at the Field Court on March 5, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until March 26, 2026.
In the case of Yoga Pratama, Maya Kartika's legal power says this matter has already gone on for two years and requests that the trial be settled in a reasonable amount of time.
Yoga Pratama works as an Info reporter in Sumatera in the Medan, a journalist's organization assessing that this case can have a lesson in the freedom of the press.
The prosecutor will read the charges to the next trial.
